base_url.correction: https://secure.geonames.org (and https://api.geonames.org) — both documented; entry URL is valid but not the only official base

free_tier_limits.correction: Free: 1000 credits/hour, 20000 credits/day (credit-based; most requests = 1 credit). Commercial: higher limits.

rate_limits.correction: Free webservices: max 1000 credits/hour and 20000 credits/day; commercial accounts have higher limits (published on export/pricing pages).

notes: Rate limits and free-tier limits are published (not unknown/not published). Auth is username query param, not a separate API key. paid_plans exist commercially.
